images.scene: An elderly father sits in an armchair in his bedchamber, one gouty leg propped on a stool, leaning forward and gesturing earnestly as he counsels his young son who stands listening by the bed.
images.alt: An old man with a bandaged leg sits in a chair advising a young man standing in a bedroom.

images.scene: A young man walks up a wooden gangplank onto a sailing ship at the busy quay of Hull harbour, a bag over his shoulder, other ships and dock crowds behind him.
images.alt: A young man carrying a bag boards a sailing ship at a crowded harbour dock.

images.scene: A small sailing ship pitches amid towering grey waves in a violent storm, spray breaking over its deck, while in the distance another ship lies dismasted and half-sunk.
images.alt: A ship tossed among enormous waves in a storm with a wrecked ship in the distance.

images.scene: Sailors on a storm-lashed deck swing axes to chop through the base of the foremast, ropes and rigging whipping loose as the tall mast begins to topple over the side.
images.alt: Sailors on a stormy deck chop down a falling ship's mast with axes.

images.scene: A crowded open rowing boat pitches close beneath the stern of a foundering ship in heavy seas, men gripping a thrown rope as sailors climb down one by one into the boat.
images.alt: Men climb from a sinking ship down a rope into a small crowded rowboat in rough seas.

images.scene: From a small boat of huddled survivors rowing toward a distant shore, they watch their abandoned ship sink stern-first into the grey heaving sea behind them.
images.alt: Survivors in a small boat watch their ship sink into the sea in the distance.
